pyq_bad.why: wrong topic: Union executive / cabinet organisation

patterns: Most asked: which State does / does not have a Legislative Council (MP, TN, Rajasthan traps; MP provided by 7th Amendment but never set up).
Councils 'cannot be dissolved but can be abolished'; Rajya Sabha presided over by a non-member (VP).
Rajya Sabha exclusive powers: Art. 312 new All-India Services (2/3 present and voting, not total), Art. 249.
Country-parliament names: China = National People's Congress, Russia = Federal Assembly (Duma lower, Federation Council upper).
UT representation: Delhi and Puducherry in presidential election (70th Amdt); UTs in both Houses.
App MCQs add Sieyes/Ayyangar arguments and AP Council history; sound but more conceptual than PYQs.
